name: DIF-Gaussian Training Pipeline
definition: A deep learning training pipeline for reconstructing 3D volumes from extremely sparse-view cone-beam CT projections, predicting point-wise values via a neural network and optimizing with MSE loss.
summary: DIF-Gaussian is a deep learning pipeline for reconstructing 3D volumes from extremely sparse-view cone-beam CT projections, differing from standard 3D Gaussian Splatting by focusing on volumetric regression rather than novel view synthesis.
